title: The webinar
hook: Setty, in bed, to the coach at his desk: You did your [bleep]ing webinar, right?
caption:
Webinar done, and now your DMs are full of "how much?" and people who vanish once you answer.
Meet Setty, the AI setter I built for coaches who sell in the DMs: he learns your offer, talks like you, waits till they're done typing and only sends your calendar to the serious ones.
Comment SETTY and he'll slide into your DMs.
